thread:
hazel: quick design follow-up from the prompt-sets review — thinking about a compact scorecard overlay when you hover a regression diff row. keeps the list dense but gives quick actions.

omar: I like dense lists but worry about discoverability. overlay needs clear visual affordance and keyboard focus target.

rachel: microcopy: overlay should show 1) last score, 2) delta, 3) quick approve/reject. keep labels short: 'Score 84', '+3' or '−5'.

tomas: accessibility: overlay must be reachable via `Tab`. prefer an explicit focusable info button instead of hover-only. screen readers should announce "Run details available".

hazel: agreed. UX idea: show a 16px info icon on hover and on focus; pressing Enter opens a mini-panel. tooltip text example: 'Score 84 (−3). Press Ctrl+O for details.'

omar: shortcut bikeshed: modifiers only. avoid single-key. surface mapping in a keyboard help modal.

rachel: color/contrast for delta chips: red/green is ok but always include +/- sign and text label for color-agnostic cues. e.g. '+3 (improved)' / '−3 (regressed)'.

tomas: implementational note: use `role=row` and `aria-describedby` linking to a hidden summary for SRs. when approval happens announce via `aria-live="polite"`: 'Scorecard approved. Undo available'.

hazel: small perf note: lazy-load the chip details and thumbnails when panel opens to avoid heavy DOM for long lists.

omar: mobile: no hover. the info icon must be tap target and persist the mini-panel; also ensure the mini-panel is dismissible via swipe or close button.

rachel: approval wording: Variant A: 'Approve / Request changes' Variant B: 'Mark OK / Mark Problem'  prefer A for clarity with reviewers. I'll post variants to @product-review.

tomas: add QA checklist: keyboard nav, SR announcements, high-contrast, reduced-motion, mobile tap targets, undo flows.

a11y-bot: reminder: shortcuts must be toggleable and documented per accessibility policy.

hazel: next steps: rachel will write microcopy variants, omar will draft keyboard map + help modal, tomas will add ARIA implementation notes, I'll update mocks. tagging @product-review for copy review.

omar: I'll drop the shortcut doc by EOD and include collision table. :thumbsup:

rachel: thanks all, will post copy options tomorrow.

tomas: I'll add the QA checklist to PRJ-5120 once Hazel creates the ticket.
